agent-evals.description: Benchmarks and evals for agent repositories (Harbor tasks, verifiers, calibration)

api.description: API contracts, compatibility and retry/idempotency semantics, REST/OpenAPI resources, and GraphQL schemas, resolvers and federation.

atlassian.description: Jira and Confluence through an Atlassian MCP server. It needs a sign-in, so connect one yourself (such as the Atlassian plugin); the pack ships none.

azure.description: Azure: prepare, validate and deploy with azd, diagnostics, resource lookup, Storage, App Insights, Entra app registration and azure-identity.

cli.description: Command-line tools: subcommands and flags, interactive prompts, progress output and shell completion.

databases.description: PostgreSQL and SQL: writing and reviewing queries, schema and index design, execution plans and tuning.

delivery.description: Quality constraints, version-verified implementation and release readiness. Complements the core spec, plan, implementation, testing and review workflows; readiness does not deploy.

dev-workflows.description: Optional workflows for code review, debugging, tests, architecture and ADRs, requirements, secure full-stack features, behavior-preserving simplification, and deprecation or schema migration. They overlap global skills, so add the pack only where requested. Ponytail runs only when explicitly invoked.

fastapi.description: FastAPI services for agents: tests, lifespan, auth, CORS, Open WebUI tool servers, and an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint in front of a graph.

foundry.description: Microsoft Foundry: agents, models, evaluation and the Foundry SDK, through the Azure MCP foundry tools.

golang.description: Go services: goroutines and channels, interfaces and generics, gRPC or REST, testing and pprof.

gradio.description: Building Gradio apps and calling Gradio apps through their API

langchain.description: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith (langchain-ai/langchain-skills)

local-inference.description: Local models on a workstation GPU: vLLM, llama.cpp and Ollama, recipes, memory sizing, benchmarks, and Meta Muse Glimmer.

mcp.description: Writing MCP servers in Python: FastMCP or the official SDK, testing, transports, Open WebUI and evaluations.

ml-engineering.description: Machine-learning engineering: training pipelines and experiment tracking, fine-tuning with LoRA or QLoRA, RAG systems, and prompt design and evaluation.

openwebui.description: Open WebUI as the chat front end for your own agents: connections, Pipes, Tools, Filters, tool servers and deployment.

performance.description: Measured browser, service, database and memory performance: matched baselines, profiling, experiment records and honest source-only audits. Uses available tools; ships no MCP server.

playwright.description: Playwright end-to-end tests: best practices and reading traces.

react.description: React and shadcn/ui front ends; with the langchain pack, LangGraph useStream chat UIs.

security.description: Secure coding and security review: authentication and authorization, input validation, the OWASP Top 10, and audit reports with remediation. Cloudflare security-audit adds coverage tracking and independent finding verification; runs only when explicitly invoked.

spring-boot.description: Spring Boot 3 services: REST controllers, Spring Security 6, Spring Data JPA and WebFlux.

sre.description: Reliability: SLOs, incidents, feature instrumentation, bounded metrics, logs, tracing, alert/runbook verification, and chaos experiments.

typescript.description: TypeScript repositories (deep-module boundaries, shoehorn test data)

vision.description: Computer vision in Python: OpenCV, and Meta SAM 3 segmentation.
